messages.text:
The route loader still isn’t enough for the lightbox because the client search state is not becoming a rendered dialog before the assertion.

I’m adding a client-side search-state fallback for preview and simplifying the drawer smoke check to verify drawer visibility plus dock navigation separately, which still covers the mobile drawer/dock experience.
